name: instructions-in-workspace
about: No tools, web search on. The workspace holds AGENTS.md, QWEN.md and docs/CLAUDE.md (below the workspace: not read); INSTRUCTIONS_MAX_CHARS 120 keeps QWEN.md whole and cuts AGENTS.md, which comes first. The instruction block closes the system prompt of every request, and the title request carries none.

workspace.AGENTS.md: Answer in exactly one sentence. Prefer plain words over jargon, and never use bullet lists in an answer.

stream.content: A compiler translates a whole program into machine code before it runs. -- Q
An interpreter reads a program and carries it out step by step as it goes. -- Q
